name: com.xmh.streamvideoplayer
description: Experimental Windows D3D11 RTSP/TCP H.264 hardware video player with FFmpeg, GPU conversion, shared textures and independent sessions. Requires locally built native libraries.

samples.description: Verifies native D3D11 render events and Unity texture lifetime without a camera or FFmpeg. Add GpuInteropDemo to an empty GameObject and enter Play mode.
RTSP/TCP H.264 player with source input and statistics. Add RtspPlayerDemo to an empty GameObject; requires the optional native FFmpeg module.
1/4/9/16 independent RTSP sessions with GPU textures and per-stream FPS. Add VideoWallDemo to an empty GameObject.
